finding: All 16 packages reconcile their assigned IDs to resolution rows: 119 assigned and 119 resolution rows; all 84 certified master IDs are represented, with 90 resolved and 29 explicitly partial rows.

The committed baseline-to-final-freeze diff contains only the 15 lecture bodies, formulas.tex, frontmatter.tex, and remediation metadata; resolution source ownership checks found zero violations. Post-final-freeze worktree changes are generated PDFs/tmp, not source edits.

The two invalidated fidelity attempts (L06 and L12) are visibly marked invalid and have accepted fresh replacements. L06/L12 remediation prompts and events name accepted retry evidence; the L12 collision registry has three records and no evidence shows invalidated content used as evidence.

After the three independent-audit repairs, the run log records successful compilation of the combined book and 15 standalone PDFs. Current artifacts measure 189 combined pages, 158 standalone pages, 347 raster pages, 173 static labels, 173 AUX labels, 61 references, and zero dangling references.

All JSON/JSONL streams parse, but event schemas are inconsistent. Lecture 10 has seven event records without an event key; event type spelling varies, and only 7 of 16 packages have a machine-readable validation event.
impact: Completion and validation cannot be mechanically audited uniformly; 9 packages claim complete/completed without a validation event.

finding: The manifest declares gpt-5.6-luna/high, but none of the 16 worker packages records a per-package model or attempt identifier. The policy is therefore auditable only as a run-level declaration, not as worker-level provenance.
impact: A future mixed-model, retry, or handoff cannot be reliably attributed from the remediation package alone.

finding: The run log names one explicit status correction (ADJ-083), four named lecture-side corrections, 14 cross-book repair classes, final layout/reference fixes, and a later three-defect independent-audit recovery. These interventions improved the result, but the worker packages do not separate initial output from coordinator-edited resolution content.
impact: Worker quality and coordinator recovery effort cannot be measured at edit level; the initial source-freeze claim was premature as a mathematical certification claim.

finding: The manifest marks all lecture and cross-book work complete while its resolution_audit phase remains running, even though the fresh final audit certifies f952a54. This is a stale state-model field, not evidence that a source fix is missing.
impact: Downstream consumers cannot distinguish source-freeze completion from audit closure without reading the final audit artifact.

finding: Use capability-gated Stage B access, pre-created absolute artifact paths, one shared JSON schema, schema-gated completion, reason-coded fresh-context retries, per-worker model/attempt IDs, and independent source/build checks before freezing.

The independent resolution auditor at b73e168 found three residual mathematical/notation defects after all workers and the coordinator had declared source editing frozen. The coordinator repaired all three in f952a54, rebuilt all 16 targets, and reran references; the fresh independent audit against f952a54 certified 84/84 resolved and verified that no new defect was introduced.
impact: Ledger completeness and clean builds did not imply mathematical certification at the first freeze. The eventual independent consumer-level gate worked and certified the corrected source.
